proofOfDiagnosis: Histopathology: glioblastoma, WHO grade 4 (WHO CNS 2021 classification).
IDH-wildtype. 1p/19q not co-deleted. MGMT promoter not methylated.
Location recorded by the treating team: right frontal lobe.
Pre-operative tumour volume from the collection's segmentation: about 17 mL.
Recorded by the collection as enhancing; T2/FLAIR hyperintensity recorded as absent.

referenceReport.technique: MRI brain at 3 T: axial T2, axial T2 FLAIR, 3D axial T1 post-contrast, 3D axial T2 (SPACE). No pre-contrast T1, diffusion, susceptibility or perfusion sequences are included in the published study. Images are defaced.
